visualCharacteristics: Interactive testimonial tabs: a row of avatar-card labels (photo + name + role) that switch an image/quote panel. Active panel shows a large portrait image beside the person's name, role, and quote.
contentPattern: One row per testimonial. First cell: avatar-card label (image + name + role). Remaining cell(s): panel content (portrait image + quote text).
usage: Testimonials or team quotes presented as switchable tabs with avatar labels.
